assumptions: A-DSP-1a: one 18x18->36 MAC, 1 pass/cycle; wider multiplies decompose into ceil(w/18)^2 sequential passes.

A-ALU-1: add/sub/compare/shift on <=32-bit two's-complement words cost 1 cycle at every candidate clock. NOT verified by timing analysis; at 480 MHz a 32-bit carry chain may need pipelining, which would raise add costs proportionally.

A-MEM-1: on-chip state RAM is a single-port 1RW synchronous SRAM macro, 1-cycle read OR write, no dual-port; a same-macro read+write pair serializes (2 cycles). Dual-macro duplication (2x bits, read and write in one cycle) is named A-MEM-2 where a probe uses it.

A-ALU-2: no division in any audio-rate path. Divisions in the source algorithms are replaced by multiply-by-precomputed-inverse with the inverse recomputed at coefficient rate (named per probe where used).

A-CLK: F in {48, 96, 192, 480} MHz are CANDIDATE clock hypotheses for the closure formula; none is verified achievable in gf180mcu (no synthesis run). The closure check is arithmetic on the formula in plan section 5 only.
Reload mode modeled: per-sample coefficient interpolation (candidate, NOT pinned behavior).
